character_fabrication_state_override_req.name: character_fabrication_state_override_requires_machine
character_fabrication_state_override_req.value: "character_fabrication_state"."override_load" IS NOT NULL OR ("character_fabrication_state"."override_safe_pushes" = 0 AND "character_fabrication_state"."override_exact_pushes" = 0 AND NOT "character_fabrication_state"."override_locked" AND "character_fabrication_state"."override_last_push" IS NULL)

character_missions_completion_requires_a.name: character_missions_completion_requires_acceptance
character_missions_completion_requires_a.value: "character_missions"."completed_at" IS NULL OR "character_missions"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL

character_travel_state_scavenge_window_m.name: character_travel_state_scavenge_window_matches_mode
character_travel_state_scavenge_window_m.value: ("character_travel_state"."mode" = 'walk' AND "character_travel_state"."scavenge_opportunity_start_tick" IS NOT NULL AND "character_travel_state"."scavenge_opportunity_start_tick" >= 3 AND "character_travel_state"."scavenge_opportunity_start_tick" <= 30) OR ("character_travel_state"."mode" <> 'walk' AND "character_travel_state"."scavenge_opportunity_start_tick" IS NULL)

character_work_order_postings_progress_r.name: character_work_order_postings_progress_requires_acceptance
character_work_order_postings_progress_r.value: "character_work_order_postings"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL OR ("character_work_order_postings"."sections_completed" = 0 AND "character_work_order_postings"."clean_pass" IS NULL)

chat_messages_sender_check.name: chat_messages_sender_check
chat_messages_sender_check.value:
("chat_messages"."kind" = 'player') = ("chat_messages"."sender_player_account_id" is not null and "chat_messages"."sender_character_id" is not null and "chat_messages"."sender_character_name" is not null)
        and ("chat_messages"."kind" = 'player' or ("chat_messages"."sender_player_account_id" is null and "chat_messages"."sender_character_id" is null and "chat_messages"."sender_character_name" is null and "chat_messages"."channel" = 'general'))

moderation_appeals_decision_paired_check.name: moderation_appeals_decision_paired_check
moderation_appeals_decision_paired_check.value: ("moderation_appeals"."outcome" is null) = ("moderation_appeals"."decided_at" is null) and ("moderation_appeals"."outcome" is null) = ("moderation_appeals"."decided_by_admin_user_id" is null)

moderation_cases_opened_by_check.name: moderation_cases_opened_by_check
moderation_cases_opened_by_check.value: ("moderation_cases"."opened_by" = 'report' and "moderation_cases"."opened_by_admin_user_id" is null and "moderation_cases"."opening_reason" is null) or ("moderation_cases"."opened_by" = 'operator' and "moderation_cases"."opened_by_admin_user_id" is not null and "moderation_cases"."opening_reason" is not null)

moderation_sanctions_duration_check.name: moderation_sanctions_duration_check
moderation_sanctions_duration_check.value: ("moderation_sanctions"."kind" = 'warning' and "moderation_sanctions"."duration" is null and "moderation_sanctions"."ends_at" is null) or ("moderation_sanctions"."kind" <> 'warning' and "moderation_sanctions"."duration" is not null and "moderation_sanctions"."duration" in ('24h', '7d', '30d', '90d', '1y', 'permanent') and ("moderation_sanctions"."duration" = 'permanent') = ("moderation_sanctions"."ends_at" is null))

operator_audit_logs_target_shape_check.name: operator_audit_logs_target_shape_check
operator_audit_logs_target_shape_check.value: ("operator_audit_logs"."target_kind" = 'character' and "operator_audit_logs"."character_id" is not null and "operator_audit_logs"."player_account_id" is null) or ("operator_audit_logs"."target_kind" = 'player_account' and "operator_audit_logs"."player_account_id" is not null and "operator_audit_logs"."character_id" is null) or ("operator_audit_logs"."target_kind" = 'system' and "operator_audit_logs"."character_id" is null and "operator_audit_logs"."player_account_id" is null)

player_reports_message_check.name: player_reports_message_check
player_reports_message_check.value: ("player_reports"."kind" = 'message') = ("player_reports"."message_id" is not null and "player_reports"."channel" is not null and "player_reports"."evidence" is not null)

player_trade_sessions_settlement_refusal.name: player_trade_sessions_settlement_refusal_check
player_trade_sessions_settlement_refusal.value: ("player_trade_sessions"."settlement_refusal" is null or "player_trade_sessions"."settlement_refusal" in ('offer_unavailable', 'inventory_full', 'too_heavy', 'last_cutter', 'credit_limit', 'ineligible', 'empty_trade')) and ("player_trade_sessions"."settlement_refusal_side" is null or ("player_trade_sessions"."settlement_refusal" is not null and "player_trade_sessions"."settlement_refusal_side" in ('requester', 'recipient')))
